metadata.question: Were there fewer fire detections in Brazil in 2019 than in 2007?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about fire detections in Brazil in 2007 vs 2019. I need to: 1. Use MODIS Active Fire data (MCD14ML) which is suitable for fire detection analysis 2. Define Brazil geometry using FAO GAUL dataset 3. Filter the fire detection collection for both years 4. Count the number of fire detections in each year 5. Compare and determine if 2019 had fewer detections than 2007 For data quality: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Count fire detections to validate data exists - Simple comparison logic The MODIS MCD14ML collection provides fire detection points that I can count directly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Brazil geometry var brazil = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Brazil')); // Get MODIS Active Fire detections var fires2007 = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') .filterBounds(brazil) .filter(ee.Filter.date('2007-01-01', '2007-12-31')); var fires2019 = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') .filterBounds(brazil) .filter(ee.Filter.date('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31')); // Check if collections are empty var count2007 = fires2007.size().getInfo(); var count2019 = fires2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2007 Fire Detections: ${count2007}`); console.log(`2019 Fire Detections: ${count2019}`); if (count2007 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Compare fire detections var fewerIn2019 = count2019 < count2007; if (fewerIn2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
